item.title: Miles scores career-high 40 points, hits 10 3-pointers as No. 17 TCU women beat No. 12 Baylor 83-67
item.description: Olivia Miles poured in career highs with 40 points and 10 3-pointers to lead No. 17 TCU 83-67 over No. 12 Baylor on Thursday.

item.title: Five players score in double figures, Maryland rolls late to defeat Penn State 81-62
item.description: Yarden Garzon led with 19 points, four other Terrapins scored in double figures, and No. 20 Maryland took down Penn State 81-62 on Thursday night.

item.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump officials from rescinding health grants to some Democratic-led states
item.description: A federal judge has ruled that President Donald Trump's administration cannot pull back $600 million in public health grants allocated to four Democratic-led states, for now.

item.title: Miami University embracing the pressure as Division I's last unbeaten
item.description: Miami stays unbeaten and keeps rolling, even as the last perfect team in Division I.

item.title: Great Neck South boys, girls fencing teams win second Long Island title in three years
item.description: The boys finished 12-2 and the girls completed a 14-0 season.

item.title: Massapequa gymnastics' Lexi Cuthbert, Samantha Hogan help team earn first Nassau title since 2017
item.description: Freshman Lexi Cuthbert won on bars (9.35) and qualified to compete on bars and beam at the state meet.

item.title: Bangladesh Nationalist Party claims victory in country's first election since 2024 uprising
item.description: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party claims it won the country's first election since the 2024 uprising, positioning itself to form the next government and potentially reshape Bangladesh's political landscape after years of intense rivalry and disputed polls.

item.title: No. 10 Oklahoma rallies past Florida 81-74 behind Zya Vann's 18 points
item.description: Zya Vann scored 18 points and Peyton Verhulst had 16 points and nine rebounds as No. 10 Oklahoma rallied to beat Florida 81-74.

item.title: Mikayla Blakes scores 34 points to help No. 5 Vanderbilt beat No. 4 Texas 86-70
item.description: NCAA scoring leader Mikayla Blakes had 34 points, Aubrey Galvan added 18 points and eight rebounds and No. 5 Vanderbilt beat No. 4 Texas 86-70 on Thursday night.

item.title: Christian Siriano invites New York Fashion Week guests into his surrealist dream
item.description: Rather than rely on a dramatic set, Designer Christian Siriano let his designs speak for themselves Thursday at his New York Fashion Week show.
